findings.title: Benchmark and evolution consumers promote unexecuted or caller-supplied evidence to PASS and AWAITING_HUMAN
findings.trigger: Build a candidate bundle without supplied case results, then compare it or pass a raw comparison object to evaluateEvolution.

reproduction.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { buildCandidateBundle } from './.agents/scripts/benchmark-v4.mjs'; const b=buildCandidateBundle(process.cwd(), { source_paths: [] }); console.log(JSON.stringify(b.cases.map(x => ({case_id:x.case_id, check_results:x.check_results, correction_cycles:x.correction_cycles, coverage:x.coverage, input_digest:x.input_digest}))))"
reproduction.observed: All L/M/H cases receive check_results=[{id:'corpus-guard',status:'PASS',tests:3,coverage:'DETERMINISTIC'}], correction_cycles=0, coverage=DETERMINISTIC, input_digest=null; no scenario runner was called.
The command returns COMPARABLE with metrics.quality=PASS and exit code 0, although the candidate bundle contains only the synthetic corpus-guard record and no case execution evidence.
The consumer returns EVALUATED/AWAITING_HUMAN and labels token_savings MEASURED for an empty observed_usage object supplied by the caller.

findings.expected_invariant: Missing, legacy, stale, failed, skipped, timeout, or unbound evidence cannot become quality PASS, EVALUATED, or AWAITING_HUMAN. Every L/M/H case must have an actual execution binding, input digest, runner/source identity, raw output reference and assertion result; expected rejection remains raw status plus a separate passing assertion.
findings.actual: The schema is still v1; validateCase allows null input_digest and lacks execution/evidence binding requirements. buildCandidateBundle supplies PASS, tests:3, correction_cycles:0 and DETERMINISTIC defaults. compareBundles derives quality solely from those statuses. evaluateEvolution trusts caller-provided usage/check arrays without validating evidence binding or coverage.
findings.impact: The review pipeline can report deterministic quality and adoption readiness without running the required scenarios or measuring provider usage. This is an evidence/authority boundary failure, not a cosmetic reporting issue.
findings.minimal_fix_scope: Batch B R02-R03: introduce the v2 evidence contract and actual L/M/H runner, fail closed on missing/legacy/unbound evidence, preserve raw statuses, and require the evidence root/binding in compare and evolution consumers.
regression_required: No check_results produces UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
Missing/duplicate/tampered/cross-case evidence is invalid or incomplete.
M expected INCOMPLETE remains raw INCOMPLETE while its assertion can PASS.
A caller-supplied empty or unbound usage object cannot make evaluation AWAITING_HUMAN.

findings.title: The worktree plan marks the original U2 acceptance complete despite evidence that the target was not met
findings.trigger: Read the W plan status, T11 evidence, validation report and migration note together.

reproduction.observed: The W plan says COMPLETE, its U2 DoD checkbox is [x], and the T11/validation evidence says candidate instruction bytes are larger than baseline: +21,525 implement aggregate and +22,254 verify aggregate.

findings.expected_invariant: The original acceptance remains the authority: both normal implement_slice and verify_slice must reduce instruction bytes by at least 30% on a valid comparable basis while preserving invariants. If not measured or not met, U2 remains OPEN/NOT_MET/INCONCLUSIVE. A changed acceptance requires a separate human decision.
findings.actual: The plan and migration/validation wording present implementation completion while acknowledging that the bundle does not prove savings and that the candidate is larger. No independent review disposition is recorded in the W before Batch A.
findings.impact: A downstream reviewer or human could interpret a checked DoD and COMPLETE/PASS wording as acceptance of the original U2 scope, despite contrary evidence.
findings.minimal_fix_scope: R00 report/status update: mark the current validation under review, reopen U2 acceptance, preserve the historical implementer evidence, and explicitly separate implemented/reported/independently verified. Do not change the 30% criterion without a human decision.
regression_required: The plan keeps the original U2 wording and records a separate open/not-met/inconclusive disposition.
No report calls the original scope PASS_ORIGINAL_SCOPE before R08.
A human decision is required if a different acceptance scope is proposed.

findings.title: Instruction-byte measurement does not bind both revisions to one reproducible basis
findings.trigger: Compare the historical baseline bundle with the candidate bundle and inspect the implementation of measureInstructionBytes.

reproduction.observed: The compare path ignores the instruction_bytes.basis key, accepts explicit source-path/binding disclosures, and aggregates the same 30,565/37,740/37,983 values across all three cases. It reports 91,695 baseline versus 113,220 candidate for implement and 91,695 versus 113,949 for verify.
False; no revision-bound measurement helper or basis manifest exists in H0.

findings.expected_invariant: The measurement method, profile, action, input and required source manifest must be identical in meaning for B and candidate; raw Git blobs at the named revisions are counted once, missing required sources fail closed, and per-action measurements are not multiplied by repeated L/M/H rows.
findings.actual: measureInstructionBytes reads the current checkout, hard-codes a path list per action, catches missing files and adds zero, and compareBundles drops the basis key and sums per-case values without validating a shared measurement basis. The baseline basis string describes four pre-T02 sources while its source bindings list eight paths; the candidate basis string describes a different current-source set.
findings.impact: The resulting delta is not a reproducible U2 acceptance metric. It can include or exclude required instructions asymmetrically, count a missing source as zero, and multiply one static context measurement by corpus rows.
findings.minimal_fix_scope: Batch B R04: add a versioned instruction-basis manifest and Git-revision measurement helper; record path/blob/bytes/inclusion reason; fail closed on missing or triggered lazy sources; compare basis/profile/action/input coverage before reporting a metric.
regression_required: UTF-8/multibyte and CRLF byte counts are measured from the named Git revision.
Missing required source and triggered lazy source are INCONCLUSIVE/INVALID, never zero.
Different basis/profile/action/input makes the metric INCONCLUSIVE even when prose supplies a reason.
L/M/H rows do not turn one static measurement into three independent samples.
